# PT. Rinjani Medika Bersama

> Distributor alat kesehatan instrument dan implan orthopedic terpercaya di Indonesia, menyediakan produk stainless steel buatan Pakistan sejak 2019.

## Pages

- [Home](https://healthcare-distributor-hq.preview.imagine.bo/): Landing page featuring the hero section, company introduction (Tentang Kami), product category grid, why-choose-us highlights, an editorial list of instrument sets (Orthopedic, Kebidanan, THT, Fess, Mayor, Laparatomy, Palatoplasty, Vascular), a searchable/filterable product list, featured products grid, a catalog download section, and a contact form for inquiries.
